verses.name: Psalms 119:1
verses.text: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:2
verses.text: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

verses.name: Psalms 119:3
verses.text: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

verses.name: Psalms 119:4
verses.text: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

verses.name: Psalms 119:5
verses.text: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

verses.name: Psalms 119:6
verses.text: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:7
verses.text: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:8
verses.text: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:9
verses.text: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:10
verses.text: With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:11
verses.text: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

verses.name: Psalms 119:12
verses.text: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:13
verses.text: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 119:14
verses.text: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

verses.name: Psalms 119:15
verses.text: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

verses.name: Psalms 119:16
verses.text: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:17
verses.text: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:18
verses.text: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:19
verses.text: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:20
verses.text: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

verses.name: Psalms 119:21
verses.text: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:22
verses.text: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:23
verses.text: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:24
verses.text: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.

verses.name: Psalms 119:25
verses.text: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

verses.name: Psalms 119:26
verses.text: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:27
verses.text: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

verses.name: Psalms 119:28
verses.text: My soul is weary with sorrow: strengthen me according to your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:29
verses.text: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

verses.name: Psalms 119:30
verses.text: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:31
verses.text: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.

verses.name: Psalms 119:32
verses.text: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.

verses.name: Psalms 119:33
verses.text: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

verses.name: Psalms 119:34
verses.text: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

verses.name: Psalms 119:35
verses.text: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

verses.name: Psalms 119:36
verses.text: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

verses.name: Psalms 119:37
verses.text: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

verses.name: Psalms 119:38
verses.text: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

verses.name: Psalms 119:39
verses.text: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

verses.name: Psalms 119:40
verses.text: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 119:41
verses.text: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:42
verses.text: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:43
verses.text: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

verses.name: Psalms 119:44
verses.text: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

verses.name: Psalms 119:45
verses.text: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:46
verses.text: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

verses.name: Psalms 119:47
verses.text: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

verses.name: Psalms 119:48
verses.text: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:49
verses.text: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

verses.name: Psalms 119:50
verses.text: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:51
verses.text: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:52
verses.text: I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.

verses.name: Psalms 119:53
verses.text: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:54
verses.text: Your statutes have been my songs, in the house where I live.

verses.name: Psalms 119:55
verses.text: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:56
verses.text: This is my way, that I keep your precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:57
verses.text: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

verses.name: Psalms 119:58
verses.text: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:59
verses.text: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:60
verses.text: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:61
verses.text: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:62
verses.text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

verses.name: Psalms 119:63
verses.text: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:64
verses.text: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:65
verses.text: Do good to your servant, according to your word, Yahweh.

verses.name: Psalms 119:66
verses.text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:67
verses.text: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:68
verses.text: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:69
verses.text: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:70
verses.text: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:71
verses.text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:72
verses.text: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.

verses.name: Psalms 119:73
verses.text: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:74
verses.text: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:75
verses.text: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:76
verses.text: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

verses.name: Psalms 119:77
verses.text: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

verses.name: Psalms 119:78
verses.text: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:79
verses.text: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:80
verses.text: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.

verses.name: Psalms 119:81
verses.text: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:82
verses.text: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

verses.name: Psalms 119:83
verses.text: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:84
verses.text: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

verses.name: Psalms 119:85
verses.text: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:86
verses.text: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

verses.name: Psalms 119:87
verses.text: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:88
verses.text: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.

verses.name: Psalms 119:89
verses.text: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.

verses.name: Psalms 119:90
verses.text: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

verses.name: Psalms 119:91
verses.text: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

verses.name: Psalms 119:92
verses.text: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

verses.name: Psalms 119:93
verses.text: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:94
verses.text: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:95
verses.text: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:96
verses.text: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.

verses.name: Psalms 119:97
verses.text: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

verses.name: Psalms 119:98
verses.text: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:99
verses.text: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

verses.name: Psalms 119:100
verses.text: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:101
verses.text: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:102
verses.text: I have not turned aside from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:103
verses.text: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

verses.name: Psalms 119:104
verses.text: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.

verses.name: Psalms 119:105
verses.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

verses.name: Psalms 119:106
verses.text: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

verses.name: Psalms 119:107
verses.text: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:108
verses.text: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.

verses.name: Psalms 119:109
verses.text: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:110
verses.text: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:111
verses.text: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

verses.name: Psalms 119:112
verses.text: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end.

verses.name: Psalms 119:113
verses.text: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:114
verses.text: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:115
verses.text: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

verses.name: Psalms 119:116
verses.text: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

verses.name: Psalms 119:117
verses.text: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

verses.name: Psalms 119:118
verses.text: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

verses.name: Psalms 119:119
verses.text: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

verses.name: Psalms 119:120
verses.text: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:121
verses.text: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.

verses.name: Psalms 119:122
verses.text: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:123
verses.text: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:124
verses.text: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:125
verses.text: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

verses.name: Psalms 119:126
verses.text: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:127
verses.text: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

verses.name: Psalms 119:128
verses.text: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.

verses.name: Psalms 119:129
verses.text: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

verses.name: Psalms 119:130
verses.text: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

verses.name: Psalms 119:131
verses.text: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:132
verses.text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

verses.name: Psalms 119:133
verses.text: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:134
verses.text: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:135
verses.text: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:136
verses.text: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:137
verses.text: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.

verses.name: Psalms 119:138
verses.text: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

verses.name: Psalms 119:139
verses.text: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

verses.name: Psalms 119:140
verses.text: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

verses.name: Psalms 119:141
verses.text: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:142
verses.text: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

verses.name: Psalms 119:143
verses.text: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

verses.name: Psalms 119:144
verses.text: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.

verses.name: Psalms 119:145
verses.text: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:146
verses.text: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:147
verses.text: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

verses.name: Psalms 119:148
verses.text: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:149
verses.text: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.

verses.name: Psalms 119:150
verses.text: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:151
verses.text: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.

verses.name: Psalms 119:152
verses.text: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.

verses.name: Psalms 119:153
verses.text: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:154
verses.text: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

verses.name: Psalms 119:155
verses.text: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:156
verses.text: Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.

verses.name: Psalms 119:157
verses.text: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

verses.name: Psalms 119:158
verses.text: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:159
verses.text: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.

verses.name: Psalms 119:160
verses.text: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.

verses.name: Psalms 119:161
verses.text: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

verses.name: Psalms 119:162
verses.text: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.

verses.name: Psalms 119:163
verses.text: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

verses.name: Psalms 119:164
verses.text: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

verses.name: Psalms 119:165
verses.text: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

verses.name: Psalms 119:166
verses.text: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.

verses.name: Psalms 119:167
verses.text: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

verses.name: Psalms 119:168
verses.text: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.

verses.name: Psalms 119:169
verses.text: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:170
verses.text: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

verses.name: Psalms 119:171
verses.text: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

verses.name: Psalms 119:172
verses.text: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

verses.name: Psalms 119:173
verses.text: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

verses.name: Psalms 119:174
verses.text: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.

verses.name: Psalms 119:175
verses.text: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

verses.name: Psalms 119:176
verses.text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
